raw.description:
The job in one line

You run the CEO's operating system: goals, cadence, and follow-through. You also personally own the projects that don't have a home yet.

Everyday Dose is moving fast in a lot of directions at once. The constraint isn't ideas or effort. It's making sure the right handful of things get set, tracked, and actually finished while everything else keeps running.

That's this job. It is not an executive assistant role and it is not a note-taking role. You'll own outcomes, run the meeting the leadership team is accountable to, and have a real seat.

What You'll Actually Do

Own goal setting. Run quarterly and annual planning end to end. Sit with each exec, turn intent into targets that are measurable and few. Hold the line when a goal is a paragraph instead of a number. Publish it so the whole company knows what we're playing for.

Manage against those goals. Goals decay the week after they're written unless someone owns them. You're that someone. You track progress, surface slippage early, and escalate the things that need the CEO before they become fires.

Run the weekly leadership meeting. Set the agenda, bring the numbers, drive to decisions. Every meeting ends with owners and dates, and you chase them down between meetings. You're not the scribe; you're the person who makes the hour worth everyone's time.

Keep the scoreboard honest. Build and maintain the company-level reporting leadership runs on, in partnership with finance and data. Numbers come from the warehouse, not from someone's recollection on a call. If two sources disagree, you're the one who reconciles them.

Run special projects. The high-stakes, cross-functional thing that has no owner: a new bet, a partnership, a channel or business we're deciding whether to enter, a problem that spans three teams and belongs to none of them. You get handed ambiguity and come back with an answer, a model, and a plan.

Be the CEO's second read. Pressure-test decisions before they're made. Prep board and investor materials. Write the memo when the thinking needs to be sharp. Say the thing nobody else in the room will say.

What Success Looks Like In 90 Days

  • Company goals for the quarter are written, owned, and measurable, and every leader can recite theirs without opening a doc
  • The weekly leadership meeting has a repeatable format, a live scoreboard, and decisions that stick
  • One company-level dashboard everyone trusts, sourced from the warehouse
  • Two special projects taken from ambiguous to finished without supervision
  • The CEO's time visibly reallocated toward the highest-leverage work in the business

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 8 to 12 years of experience, including time as a Chief of Staff, BizOps lead, Strategy & Operations lead, or equivalent to a founder/CEO or a senior exec
  • Top pedigree. Strong academic background and time at companies with a known high bar, plus a record of being promoted inside them. We look hard at both
  • Left brain. You're fluent in a spreadsheet and comfortable in a data environment. You can build a model, size an opportunity, read a cohort curve, and pull your own numbers rather than filing a ticket and waiting
  • Right brain. You write exceptionally well. Memos, board decks, exec comms. You can take a messy 90-minute discussion and turn it into one page that changes what people do
  • You've run an operating cadence (OKRs or equivalent, weekly business reviews, planning cycles) at a company doing real volume, not as a theory from a deck
  • Backbone. You will regularly tell senior, accomplished people that their goal isn't measurable or their project is late. You do it without drama and without flinching, and they respect you for it
  • Startup metabolism. High ambiguity, fast context switching, nothing beneath you. You'd rather own the outcome than protect the org chart
  • You use AI tooling daily to move faster on analysis, drafting, and research

Bonus

  • DTC, subscription, or CPG experience, especially a business with recurring revenue and real retention mechanics
  • Consulting, banking, or PE foundation plus real operating experience (we're not looking for one without the other)
  • You've built materials for and presented to a board or investors
  • SQL, or enough of it to be dangerous

What this role is not

  • Not an executive assistant. You are not managing a calendar or booking travel
  • Not a project manager who takes notes and updates a tracker
  • Not a strategy role that stops at the recommendation
  • Not a functional leadership role. You won't inherit a team on day one, though this role can grow into one

If you want a clear lane and a stable scope, this isn't it, and that's fine.

How To Apply

Skip the cover letter. Instead, send us:

  • One page on an operating cadence you built or ran. What existed before, what you changed, and what measurably improved as a result
  • A time you told an executive something they didn't want to hear. What you said, and what happened
  • Short answer: A subscription business is seeing retention slip. Five executives each have a confident, different theory as to why. You have two weeks. What do you look at first, how do you get to the actual answer, and how do you land it with a leadership team that's already made up its mind?

We read these carefully. Applications without them won't move forward.

Benefits

  • Strong base, performance bonus
  • Meaningful equity because we want you to own a piece of what you build
  • Health benefits + health stipend
  • Generous time off
  • Free product

description: We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our creative team part-time (25 hours per week), with the potential to grow into a full-time opportunity. Since 1988, Miranda Creative has partnered with more than 6,000 clients across finance, hospitality, healthcare, manufacturing, tourism, and government. We're a full-service, award-winning, New England-based creative and strategic agency. We pride ourselves on being a highly inclusive, collaborative community built on creativity, trust, and joy. We welcome you to Miranda Creative and look forward to learning more about you. This role is ideal for a designer who enjoys bringing brands to life through thoughtful design, understands the importance of consistency, and has experience creating both static and motion-based content. The primary focus of this position will be supporting production needs, ensuring brand standards are implemented accurately, and helping deliver high-quality creative work across print, digital, social, and web platforms. The right candidate is organized, collaborative, detail-focused, and comfortable working within established brand systems while applying strong design judgment. We are seeking someone who is consistently available 5 hours per day ( 9 to 2 EST), and who is located in the Eastern Standard time zone in order to coordinate internal and external meetings and deadlines. All candidates will be asked to provide a link to their portfolio, professional references, and confirmation of their scheduling availability. We look forward to hearing from you. Key Responsibilities Support the creative team with ongoing production design needs Accurately implement brand guidelines across print, digital, social media, and marketing materials Ensure consistency, quality, and attention to detail across all deliverables Prepare production-ready files for print and digital applications Adapt existing creative concepts into multiple formats and platforms Manage design updates, revisions, and ongoing brand-related projects Create motion graphics, animations, and video edits for digital content Support the development of social media assets, including short-form video and animated content Assist with website and digital design projects using Figma Collaborate with creative leadership and project teams to meet deadlines and maintain quality standards Maintain organized files and follow established creative workflows Requirements 3+ years of professional graphic design experience Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, composition, and visual hierarchy Ability to work within established brand guidelines with accuracy and consistency Strong production skills and excellent attention to detail Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud, including: Adobe Illustrator Adobe Photoshop Adobe InDesign Adobe After Effects and/or Premiere Pro Experience creating motion graphics, animations, and video edits Proficiency in Figma for digital design, collaboration, and presentation Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a remote environment Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with a remote team Preferred Qualifications Experience working in an agency or fast-paced creative environment Experience supporting established brands and large-scale marketing campaigns Understanding of digital design systems and responsive web design Experience preparing files for print production Knowledge of animation principles and video storytelling Ability to identify design or production issues before they impact timelines Benefits This part time role is eligible for pro-rated paid time off benefits. The part-time salary range for this position is $35,000 to $40,000, with salary commensurate with skills and experience. title: Video Editor Reacts
description: About Us Beast Industries is a multifaceted media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson, popularly known as MrBeast, the most watched person in the world. Renowned for revolutionizing digital content creation, Beast Industries encompasses a diverse portfolio of ventures that extend far beyond its origins on YouTube. With a mission to entertain, inspire, and create significant social impact, Beast Industries operates across various domains including digital media, philanthropy, consumer products, and innovative business initiatives. At Beast Industries, we believe in the transformative power of digital media and its potential to entertain, educate, and effect positive change. Our commitment to innovation, creativity, and philanthropy drives us to explore new frontiers, create unforgettable experiences, and build a legacy that inspires future generations. About the Role MrBeast is looking for a data-driven, creative, and fast-paced Video Editor to join our Content & Post-Production team working on the MrBeast Reacts channel. This role is for a master-level editor who lives and breathes YouTube culture, capable of transforming raw multi-cam reaction feeds into hyper-engaging content that keeps millions of viewers locked in. You will thrive in a high-feedback environment, balancing aggressive production schedules with a relentless obsession for frame-by-frame pacing and audience retention. What You'll Do Cut and assemble raw multi-cam reaction footage, seamlessly balancing primary talent commentary, PIP source media, and visual punch-ins. Engineer high-retention video intros and hooks that immediately fulfill title and thumbnail promises within the first 30 seconds. Execute hyper-fast pacing, comedic timing, and visual pop-ups, including kinetic typography, memes, and custom tracking graphics. Perform high-quality sound design, including impactful SFX, dynamic music ducking, and precise audio balancing for voice clarity. Collaborate closely with Lead Editors and creative teams to incorporate rapid turnaround notes and feedback loops. Analyze YouTube retention curves alongside lead editors to pinpoint drop-off moments and refine pacing rules for subsequent edits. Maintain clean, highly organized timeline projects in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, adhering to internal post-production standards. Coordinate with the thumbnail team to ensure visual assets and key video climaxes align perfectly with channel creative strategy. Stay ahead of internet culture and viral editing meta to continuously inject fresh humor and visual variety into channel content. What We're Looking For 3+ years of professional video editing experience focused on high-pacing YouTube, commentary, or viral digital content. Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Adobe After Effects, specifically with keyframing, motion tracking, masking, and dynamic linking. Deep structural understanding of YouTube algorithm dynamics, Average View Duration (AVD), CTR, and retention curve analysis. Mastery of dynamic sound design, audio leveling, and music curation to enhance comedic and emotional shifts. A data-driven mindset that prioritizes viewer retention evidence over personal creative assumptions. High feedback sensitivity, with the ability to handle rapid creative criticism constructively and pivot quickly. Exceptional attention to detail, maintaining frame-by-frame precision in pacing and visual overlays. Proven ability to manage high-volume workflows, including file compression, color correction, and final exports optimized for YouTube. Extreme ownership over end-to-end video performance, production deadlines, and technical accuracy. Benefits The Perks, Why Work On the MrBeast Team We are redefining what entertainment and storytelling look like at global scale. Every piece of content we publish reaches millions and influences culture in real time. This is your opportunity to lead the team that decides how those moments come to life across every screen. raw.description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

title: Web Publisher Half time US Timezone
description: We are eStoreLabs , a data-driven eCommerce powerhouse with strategic advisory capabilities. As an agile-oriented eCommerce company, we serve global enterprises and help build online sales for brands. We provide measurable results through performance-based custom strategies tailored to your needs. We are passionate about helping businesses grow faster and more efficiently. Our team of experts is creative, highly professional, and accountable. And they have only one goal: to supercharge clients' brands and help them acquire and retain customers. Requirements Availability 4 hours per day in the US time zone (for example 11 AM-3 PM Eastern Time - New York Time, to be confirmed Availability for 2-4 additional hours per day if needed (to be paid additionally) At least 2 year experience in web publishing type of work (building pages in a Content Management System) English language at a level of C1 or higher Time management and prioritization skills Previous work with project managers and knowledge of the project/task flow Experience with ticketing tools Experience with Figma designs as a base of intended page/site layouts HTML & CSS basic knowledge Clear communication skills Previous work with pharmaceutical companies is a plus Drupal knowledge is a plus. Responsibilities Create, edit, and publish web pages in line with design specifications and project requirements. Implement website updates with accuracy, attention to detail, and a strong focus on quality. Collaborate closely with the Project Manager throughout the entire project lifecycle, from design handoff to approvals and final publication. Communicate effectively with stakeholders via the ticketing system, ensuring clear and timely updates on assigned tasks. Participate in ad hoc project meetings or catch-up calls when required. Respond quickly to feedback and implement changes during the approval process to keep projects moving and meet deadlines. Proven ability to establish and manage strategic relationships with insurance brokers and benefit providers while evaluating plan design and cost-saving opportunities. Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex benefits information for employees and leadership. Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills. title: People Operations Manager
description: Evio Overview Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions. In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reformârapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation. â¨ Evio has advancedâ¯analytics and contracting capabilities at scale , and a suite of digital tools , to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing âflywheelâ where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an âOnly Evio can do that,â mindset and prioritization. Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves. Evio's Values Empathy â The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit. Diversity â We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights â one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all. Adventure â We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity. Relentless â Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other. Transparency â Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate. Excellence â We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard. People Operations Manager About The Role As People Operations Manager, you'll execute the operational foundation of the teammate experience at Evio. Reporting to the Head of Evio Experience, you'll help ensure every stage of the teammate experience is thoughtful, well-executed, and compliant. Evio is a growing company with increasing teammate support needs. This is a hands-on role where you'll serve as Evio's subject matter expert on benefits, administer people operations, manage our people systems and vendor relationships, and ensure teammates receive timely, knowledgeable support throughout their time at Evio. We're looking for someone with a service-oriented mindset who takes pride in delivering an exceptional teammate experience through operational excellence, responsiveness, and continuous improvement. Success in this role means teammates know they can count on you for accurate answers, thoughtful support, and reliable execution, while managers trust you to keep logistics running smoothly behind the scenes. What You'll Do Administer benefits and support teammates Administer Evio's benefits programs, including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), disability, COBRA, and other benefit offerings. Become Evio's internal expert on benefit programs, providing timely, knowledgeable support to teammates and helping them navigate questions and life events. Resolve benefit issues by partnering closely with teammates, brokers, carriers, and vendors. Administer leaves of absence and workplace accommodations. Manage relationships with benefits brokers, vendors, and other external partners. Recommend improvements to benefits and people policies based on teammate feedback, operational insights, and evolving business needs. Own people systems and operational excellence Own the day-to-day administration of people systems, including Justworks and future people technology platforms. Ensure people systems, teammate records, workflows, and documentation remain accurate, organized, and up to date. Document, maintain, and continuously improve people processes to support consistency and scale. Maintain SOC-related people operations controls and documentation. Identify practical opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational processes. Support policies and compliance Help maintain the teammate handbook and people policies. Ensure required employment notices and documentation remain current. Partner with Legal and the Head of Evio Experience to support employment law compliance. Maintain documentation standards and consistent employment practices. Help ensure leave, accommodation, and employment practices are administered consistently and compliantly. Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reformârapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation. â¨

title: VP Revenue
description: Mongoose is the leading AI Engagement Platform in higher education. Colleges and universities use us to increase enrollment, retention, and fundraising &mdash; without adding staff. We have the product and the customers. What we don't have yet is a revenue engine to match. That's this role. As VP of Revenue, you own it end to end &mdash; new business, client success, account management, and, most importantly, the system that ties them together. Your job is to make it simple and run it with discipline. What You'll Do Own all of revenue. The whole revenue org reports to you &mdash; one team, one leader. New business, client success, and account management are the front line, with enablement and operations behind them &mdash; the training and tools that set them up to win. It all serves one goal: grow ARR &mdash; by winning new business and helping our customers succeed. So you're measured on two things: new ARR and gross retention. Build a simple, repeatable selling system. One clear path from first call to close to renewal &mdash; the stages, standards, and playbooks the whole team runs the same way. Make it so clear that reps know what good looks like and spend their time selling, not guessing. Done right, it shows up in forecasts you can trust, faster deals, and better conversion at every step. Grow the people who sell it. Our reps are early in their careers and hungry, so growing them isn't a side project &mdash; it's the job. You build the system that does it: ramp, enablement, and a steady coaching cadence. And you're in it, not above it &mdash; in the deals and the reviews, helping close and coaching the fundamentals in the moment, not from a slide at quarter's end. The result is reps who sell with real confidence and conviction: they know how to win, and they believe they will. Move us up-market. Our next stage of growth is in bigger deals. You know where the real opportunity lives in higher ed, and you focus the team there &mdash; raising the ACV we pursue, building around the highest-value accounts, and growing the ones with real upside. It takes sharp market judgment, a head for the numbers, and the discipline to say no to deals that aren't worth the team's time. Run revenue like an AI company. Most revenue orgs still operate the way they did decades ago &mdash; we won't. We sell AI for a living, and the whole company is getting far more efficient, accurate, and effective by letting AI do the manual work. That takes more than watching for the next AI tool &mdash; it takes imagination: you picture how technology could reinvent the work, then we build it. What You'll Bring You've run a full revenue org &mdash; new business and retention both &mdash; and carried a number yourself, not just managed people who carried theirs. When a number gets missed, you go straight to the funnel math &mdash; pipeline, conversion, time-in-stage &mdash; not the story about why. You've built a selling system that works &mdash; whether you stood it up from scratch or overhauled a broken one inside an established org. You're a real coach. You've taken early-career reps and turned them into closers &mdash; hands-on, not from a dashboard. You think in unit economics and read a market fast. You've moved a team toward bigger, better deals, and had the discipline to walk from the rest. You're already using AI to reinvent how you work, and you don't wait for permission to push it further. Higher ed or EdTech experience is a strong plus, not a must. The market has real nuance &mdash; if you haven't lived in it, show us how you'll close the gap fast. How We Work Revenue doesn't run in isolation. You're a key member of our senior leadership team &mdash; leading revenue alongside the CEO, partnering with Product and Marketing on go-to-market, and with Finance and People to run the business. Tight feedback loops, honest calls, shared decisions. We hold each other accountable to the plan &mdash; and to the whole outcome, not just our own lane. More About Mongoose 1,000+ higher ed institutions already trust Mongoose &mdash; built to give their teams exponentially more capacity across the systems they already run. AI handles the routine, so people can focus on the work that actually moves students forward &mdash; more applications completed, more students retained, more donors reached. Same team. Much bigger impact. What We Offer Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 401K with company match: 100% of the 1st 3% and 50% of the next 2% Flexible PTO Competitive Leave Policies 13 paid holidays, including a week off between Christmas and New Year’s The Basics Remote, anywhere in the US. Some travel &mdash; for customers, for big deals, and for time together as a team.   At Mongoose, we believe that diversity drives innovation, and inclusion builds stronger teams. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
